title: Model Canvas Fork and Langflow Program Canvas Borrowings
objective: Implement MF1 through MF7 and Langflow borrowings 1 through 10 across CommonPlace and Theorem without replacing canonical registry, programmable-graph, QuickJS, Extism, or coordination contracts.

items.title: Vendor and gut the OWOX model canvas
items.live_test_command: THEOREM_RUN_CANVAS_LIVE=1 THEOREM_CANVAS_LIVE_STORAGE_STATE=/absolute/path/to/storage-state.json pnpm --filter @commonplace/console exec playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts
items.evidence: Apache-2.0 fork and notices preserved; prohibited services and calls removed; 45 package tests and typecheck pass. Browser network trace remains blocked because no browser is connected.

items.title: Persist layout through the object seam
items.live_test_command: CONSOLE_LIVE_CANVAS_SMOKE=1 CONSOLE_LIVE_CANVAS_BASE=https://v2.theoremharness.com/api CONSOLE_LIVE_CANVAS_COOKIE='...' pnpm --filter @commonplace/console exec vitest run src/lib/canvas/store.live.test.ts
items.evidence: Layout-only canvas.model documents share the CanvasStore door and debounce; 11 store tests pass. Live refresh, re-login, and Railway restart remain required.

items.title: Bind the fork to observed and declared registry reads
items.live_test_command: THEOREM_RUN_CANVAS_LIVE=1 THEOREM_CANVAS_LIVE_STORAGE_STATE=/absolute/path/to/storage-state.json pnpm --filter @commonplace/console exec playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts
items.evidence: Generated contracts drive declared cards, observed ghosts, typed fields, anchored cardinality edges, and counts. Focused model tests pass; deployed cross-door invalidation remains required.

items.title: Declare through canonical registry writes
items.live_test_command: THEOREM_RUN_CANVAS_LIVE=1 THEOREM_CANVAS_LIVE_STORAGE_STATE=/absolute/path/to/storage-state.json pnpm --filter @commonplace/console exec playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts
items.evidence: Ghost and field declarations use canonical mutations, anchors, receipts, and verbatim refusals. Tenant-scope GraphQL integration passes; a deployed conflict receipt remains required.

items.title: Extend rustyred-thg-okf with the model profile
items.live_test_command: Export from the deployed Model Canvas, round-trip the bundle through a third-party OKF tool, then import it with THEOREM_RUN_CANVAS_LIVE=1
items.evidence: One Rust crate owns preview, model mapping, atomic declaration, byte-stable export, and x-theorem extension preservation. The 29-test Rust suite and the MCP preview/import/export integration pass; third-party OKF preservation remains an external oracle.

items.title: Diff and restore canonical registry versions
items.live_test_command: THEOREM_RUN_CANVAS_LIVE=1 THEOREM_CANVAS_LIVE_STORAGE_STATE=/absolute/path/to/storage-state.json pnpm --filter @commonplace/console exec playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts
items.evidence: Canonical SchemaVersion projections support tables, fields, joins, atomic restore, and receipts. Focused tests pass; deployed visual diff and restore remain required.

items.title: Wire the model canvas to theorem-canvas-compile
items.evidence: Verify First found theorem-canvas-compile compiles semantic CanvasDoc and Graph Lisp state and exposes no schema-registry projection consumer contract. A spec amendment or new versioned contract is required; no unrelated substitute was introduced.

items.title: Playground beside the graph
items.live_test_command: THEOREM_RUN_CANVAS_LIVE=1 THEOREM_CANVAS_LIVE_STORAGE_STATE=/absolute/path/to/storage-state.json pnpm --filter @commonplace/console exec playwright test --config playwright.live.config.ts
items.evidence: Run, node inspection, input/output, receipt, and spill-handle UI is implemented. Deployed stream interaction remains required.

items.title: Per-node events and drain law
items.evidence: Server-authored started, output, token, finished, error, cached, parked, and refusal events carry sequence and terminal drain markers; Rust execution tests pass.

items.title: Visible pin and invalidation
items.evidence: Pinned values replace recomputation only when explicit, emit cached liveness, and remain stale in receipt and inspection state until removed.

items.title: Per-run tweak overlay
items.evidence: Tweaks are invocation-only, do not change ProgramDefinition identity, and are copied verbatim into receipt and inspection state.

items.title: Published program as a catalog node
items.evidence: Published programs expose declared ports in the published catalog section and use the same schema-satisfaction function as every other edge.

items.title: Published program as a generated MCP tool
items.evidence: Publication registers a generated tool with program-derived input and output schemas; invocation executes the same program adapter and returns a run receipt.

items.title: Durable human-input park and resume
items.live_test_command: Run programmable_graph_apply action=run with a human-input node, restart the harness process, then call action=resume with the persisted resume_token
items.evidence: Human-input nodes persist coordination asks, parked receipts, and resume tokens through the canonical graph path. A process-restart live smoke remains required.

items.title: Starter programs
items.evidence: Empty-state starters are returned by the serving catalog and consumed by Program Canvas without a console fixture.

items.title: Catalog lifecycle flags
items.evidence: Catalog entries carry stable, beta, or legacy lifecycle metadata and the palette renders beta and legacy markers.

items.title: In-canvas authoring inside QuickJS and Extism rings
items.evidence: Eight MCP tests pass, including real QuickJS durable code-mode execution, real WAT execution through Extism, runtime receipts, schema-derived ports, durable node errors, and refusal of read-only simulation.
